label: Can off-hand hits proc Windfury Totem?

label: Do hits that deal no damage proc Windfury Totem?
short: Yes. Any main-hand hit that lands can proc it, like Sunder Armor or Rend's application.
description: Sunder Armor and the application of Rend, Rupture and Garrote land as melee hits but deal no damage themselves. The sim lets them proc Windfury Totem, as Sunder Armor did in Classic. If only hits that deal damage counted, Arms would lose about 12 DPS (about 6 Rends a fight) and Subtlety about 2.5.
source: Classic warrior tests, 2019 (magey/classic-warrior issue 7: Sunder Armor procs Windfury Totem). wowsims/forever requires damage, marked unverified in its code.

settings.rationale: Sunder Armor procs it in Classic.

settings.label: 0.1s

settings.label: Keeps the swing

label: Do two quick white swings spend one Flurry charge?

description: Flurry's haste lasts three swings. The sim lets two white swings that land within 0.5 sec, like a main-hand and an off-hand swing together, spend one charge, as the Classic sims do. If every swing spent one, Flurry would be up less of the fight: about 11 DPS less for the dual-wield Fury warrior and 3 for the two-handed one. Enhancement shamans' Flurry works the same way.
source: The Classic sims (wowsims). wowsims/forever spends a charge on every white swing, with no log cited.

short: The sim adds 25% to the whole hit, as the tooltip reads.
description: The bonus runs on the server, so the game data can't confirm it. It could cover base damage only.
source: Forever's Incinerate tooltip and script effect.

label: Do Firestone and Wizard Oil stack?
short: The presets use both. Without Wizard Oil, a warlock loses about 16 DPS.
description: Firestone and Spellstone use the same enchant type as shaman imbues and rogue poisons, not Wizard Oil's. No one has tested both together.
source: Client 70338 enchants 23480 to 23483 and 1237162 to 1237165. No beta test.

settings.label: One or the other
settings.value: Firestone or Spellstone, no Wizard Oil

settings.label: Both
settings.value: the stone and Wizard Oil

label: Do DoT ticks get Shadowform's 200% crits?
short: Yes. Shadowform covers Shadow Word: Pain, Mind Flay and Devouring Plague ticks.
description: Ticks can crit in Forever, and Shadowform's game data includes these spells. No beta log has shown the size of a tick crit yet.
source: Forever client (Shadowform). wowsims/forever. Beta tick crits on Flame Shock.

settings.value: ticks crit for 200% too

label: Will Smite's top rank get a raise?
short: The preset assumes +9%, halfway to the low ranks' share of Era damage.
description: Build 70291 raised Smite's low ranks to 0.51 of Era's damage. Ranks past level 30 still deal 0.41 to 0.43.
source: Forever client 70338. Build 70291 (ranks 1 to 4).
